critical_code_review_comments: Detail endpoint returns wrapper {"cluster": {...}} while list endpoint returns clusters as bare objects in an array — inconsistent shape between list and detail; consider unwrapping detail or wrapping list items for uniform client parsing.
Public building endpoint wraps response as {"building": {...}} — same wrapper-inconsistency observation for external consumers; documented shapes should be enforced via response_model.
